title: Coordinate vector over the two-element field
statement: For a positive integer $n$ and an index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the $i$th coordinate vector in $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$ has value $1$ at coordinate $i$ and value $0$ at every other coordinate.
